app.editor.speech.help: Create editable words and timings from the selected track or audible edit range. Each run supports up to two minutes, including ranges inside longer projects. Source timing, audio adjustments and mute are respected; selecting one track ignores other tracks’ solo. This action downloads a speech model of about 65 MiB; CPU processing can take several minutes. Audio stays on this device. Review results, especially music, singing, accents and background noise.
